enemy.name: 'Tumor'
enemy.flavour_text: A bona fide thug from the barrenlands, head to toe. They once merely wandered the wilds, but after spotting a Raythean Industries test platform dealing with a gas leakage, they've decided to risk it all and take over the entire platform to make their fortune.

abilities.text: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, permanently increases the damage inflicted by Poison Haze
Periodically sends a Rupturing Canister to the Preparation Area (grants Invisibility to all enemies except 'Tumor' when dispatched)
